# linux_systemd_unit (Data Source)

Reads the state of a systemd unit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_systemd_unit" "docker" {
  name = "docker.service"
}

output "docker_running" {
  value = data.linux_systemd_unit.docker.active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the unit, such as `nginx.service`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the unit is running.
- `active_state` (String) `ActiveState` property, such as `active` or `failed`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the unit starts at boot.
- `exists` (Boolean) Whether systemd knows the unit.
- `id` (String) Name of the unit.
- `load_state` (String) `LoadState` property, such as `loaded` or `not-found`.
- `masked` (Boolean) Whether the unit is masked.
- `sub_state` (String) `SubState` property, such as `running` or `dead`.
- `unit_file_state` (String) `UnitFileState` property, such as `enabled` or `static`.
